request: Create a 12-second before-and-after UGC cleaning review.
product_context: Cleaning product used on a visibly dirty hard surface where the same area can be shown before, during contact, and after wiping.
expected_behavior: Use a problem-solution, one-pass test, or before-after concept.
Keep the same target area visible enough to compare states.
Use the wipe reveal or half-clean comparison as the hero moment.
critical_constraints: Keep stain or dirt position consistent until physically removed.
Use a plausible cleaning speed and amount of residue.
failure_conditions: Dirt teleports or changes position before contact.
Surface becomes magically restored with no plausible action.
Before and after shots cannot be visually compared.
